items.zh: 这件外套我能试一下吗？
items.scene: 在商场服装店，你拿着外套问店员

answers.en: Can I try this jacket on?
answers.note: 最中性的问法，直接问店员能不能试，不带多余客套，普通店铺都适用。

answers.en: Mind if I try this on?
answers.note: 偏随意的征询，像同龄人说话，适合年轻店员或气氛轻松的店。

answers.en: Would it be okay if I tried this jacket on?
answers.note: 最客气，用条件句先试探，适合高档店或对方看起来不好接近时。

items.zh: 这件有大一号的吗？我穿这个有点紧。
items.scene: 试穿后觉得紧，你走出试衣间问店员

answers.en: Do you have this one size up? It's a bit tight.
answers.note: 直接说大一码并解释原因，size up 是口语常用说法，适合普通店员。

answers.en: Could I get this in the next size up? This one's too snug.
answers.note: 更礼貌完整，snug 比 tight 委婉，适合不想显得挑剔时。

answers.en: Is there a bigger size? This one's really tight.
answers.note: 最直白，只说要大码不说大几码，really tight 强调勒得难受。

items.zh: 你觉得这件拿黑色的好看，还是米色的好看？
items.scene: 和朋友在店里挑衣服，你手里拿着两个颜色

answers.en: Which do you think looks better on me, black or beige?
answers.note: 请朋友看你上身效果，重点是穿在你身上好不好看，适合认真挑颜色。

answers.en: Black or beige — which one would you go for?
answers.note: 更口语，问对方自己会选哪个，带参考别人品味的意味，适合闲聊。

answers.en: Do you think black suits me better than beige?
answers.note: suits me 偏正式，关心颜色衬不衬肤色气质，适合认真征求意见。

items.zh: 这件我昨天买的，没穿过，能退吗？
items.scene: 你拿着小票和衣服回到店里，问收银台店员

answers.en: I bought this yesterday and haven't worn it. Can I return it?
answers.note: 先交代购买时间和没穿过，再提出退货，信息完整，适合正常办理。

answers.en: Would it be possible to return this? I got it yesterday and it's unworn.
answers.note: 用 would it be possible 更客气，适合店员看起来不太好说话时。

answers.en: Can I get a refund for this? Bought it yesterday, tags still on.
answers.note: 明确要退款而非换货，补充吊牌还在，态度更有底气。

items.zh: 我想把这件换成小一号的，可以吗？
items.scene: 在店里拿着没剪吊牌的衣服问店员

answers.en: Can I exchange this for a smaller size?
answers.note: exchange 是换货的标准词，直接说明换小码，适合让店员快速办理。

answers.en: Would it be alright to swap this for a size down?
answers.note: swap 更口语，size down 指小一码，语气轻松，适合气氛随意的店。

answers.en: I'd like to switch this to a smaller size — is that okay?
answers.note: I'd like to 偏正式礼貌，switch 通用，适合百货商场客服台。

items.zh: 这件最近会打折吗？
items.scene: 在商场看中一件外套，觉得贵，问店员

answers.en: Will this go on sale anytime soon?
answers.note: go on sale 指开始打折，anytime soon 问近期，最常用，适合随口问。

answers.en: Is this going to be discounted at all?
answers.note: discounted 稍正式，at all 带试探，适合不确定店员愿不愿透露时。

answers.en: Any chance this'll be on sale soon?
answers.note: Any chance 最随意，带期待，适合年轻店员或已经聊了几句时。

items.zh: 这条裙子配白色球鞋还是高跟鞋好？
items.scene: 朋友来家里帮你挑衣服，你举着裙子问

answers.en: Should I wear this dress with white sneakers or heels?
answers.note: 直接给两个选项请朋友帮你决定，should I 把选择权交给对方。

answers.en: Do white sneakers work with this dress, or should I go with heels?
answers.note: work with 问搭不搭，go with 表示选择，像在和朋友讨论方案。

answers.en: Which would you pair with this dress — white sneakers or heels?
answers.note: pair with 偏穿搭语境，which 开头更像认真征求搭配意见。

items.zh: 这件大衣上的油点能洗掉吗？
items.scene: 你拿着沾了油渍的大衣到干洗店，问柜台老板

answers.en: Can you get this oil stain out of the coat?
answers.note: get...out 是去污的常用说法，直接问能不能洗掉，适合普通干洗店。

answers.en: Will the oil stain come out if I have this dry-cleaned?
answers.note: 更完整，点明干洗，适合想先确认效果再决定要不要洗。

answers.en: Is there any way to save this coat? There's an oil stain on it.
answers.note: 带担心语气，save 指挽救衣服，适合污渍放了很久、怕洗不掉时。

items.zh: 这双鞋的鞋跟磨歪了，还能修吗？
items.scene: 你拎着鞋到楼下修鞋摊，问师傅

answers.en: The heel on these shoes is worn down. Can you fix it?
answers.note: 先描述磨损再问能不能修，信息清楚，适合和修鞋师傅直接沟通。

answers.en: Can these be repaired, or are they too far gone?
answers.note: too far gone 指坏到没救，带自嘲，适合鞋穿很久、心里有数时。

answers.en: Is it worth fixing the heel, or should I just get new ones?
answers.note: 问修鞋值不值，暗含考虑换新，适合想听师傅给实在建议。

items.zh: 我收到的衣服颜色和图片不一样，怎么办？
items.scene: 在家拆快递，发现颜色差很多，问网店客服

answers.en: The color of the top I got doesn't match the picture. What can I do?
answers.note: 先说明问题再问怎么办，语气平和，适合文字联系客服。

answers.en: I just opened my package and the color is way off. Can I return it?
answers.note: way off 强调色差很大，直接提退货，态度更明确。

answers.en: The item arrived in a different color than shown. Could you help me resolve this?
answers.note: 最正式礼貌，resolve 请对方处理，适合平台官方客服。

items.zh: 我穿这条裙子是不是显得腿粗？
items.scene: 试衣间照镜子有点不自信，问陪你的朋友

answers.en: Does this dress make my legs look thick?
answers.note: 直接问视觉效果，thick 指显粗，语气中性，适合关系近的朋友。

answers.en: Do my legs look big in this dress?
answers.note: 更口语，big 比 thick 委婉些，适合不想把话说得太具体时。

answers.en: Is this dress flattering on my legs, or does it make them look wide?
answers.note: flattering 指显好看，先给正面选项再问，适合在意朋友感受。

items.zh: 这袖子有点长，能帮我改短吗？
items.scene: 在裁缝店试穿新衬衫，跟师傅说

answers.en: The sleeves are a bit long. Can you shorten them?
answers.note: shorten 是改短的标准说法，简单直接，裁缝一听就明白。

answers.en: Could you take the sleeves up a little?
answers.note: take up 是裁缝术语，指改短，听起来懂行，适合和师傅沟通。

answers.en: These sleeves are too long on me — is it possible to get them altered?
answers.note: altered 泛指改衣，最正式，适合第一次来、不确定服务范围时。

items.zh: 这个包能装下我的笔记本电脑吗？
items.scene: 你在店里看中一个包，朋友在旁边，你问

answers.en: Will my laptop fit in this bag?
answers.note: fit in 问装不装得下，最直接常用，适合在店里比划时问。

answers.en: Is this bag big enough for a laptop?
answers.note: 从容量大小角度问，适合同时比较两个包、想听朋友判断时。

answers.en: Do you think this has room for my laptop?
answers.note: has room for 更口语，带征求朋友意见的语气，适合闲聊式挑选。

items.zh: 你们这鞋码偏大还是偏小？
items.scene: 你在网店看鞋，拿不准码数，问在线客服

answers.en: Do these run big or small?
answers.note: run big/small 是问鞋码的标准口语，简洁，客服一看就懂。

answers.en: Should I size up or down with these?
answers.note: 问该买大还是小，适合已经知道自己平时穿几码时。

answers.en: How does the sizing run on these shoes?
answers.note: sizing 更正式完整，适合想听客服详细说明偏码情况。

items.zh: 这件上衣配牛仔裤好看吗？
items.scene: 在店里试了上衣，想听听店员的搭配建议

answers.en: Does this top go with jeans?
answers.note: go with 是搭配的日常说法，简单直接，适合随口问店员。

answers.en: Would this top work with jeans, or should I try something else?
answers.note: work with 更中性，后半句表示还在考虑别的，适合请店员给建议。

answers.en: How does this top look with jeans?
answers.note: 问整体效果而非搭不搭，范围更宽，适合想要直观评价时。

items.zh: 这个能用优惠券吗？
items.scene: 在收银台结账，你手机里有店里的优惠券

answers.en: Can I use a coupon for this?
answers.note: 最常用问法，中性直接，结账时问收银员不会显得唐突。

answers.en: Do you take coupons here?
answers.note: take coupons 指店里收不收券，更随意，适合小店或先确认规则。

answers.en: Is this eligible for the coupon discount?
answers.note: eligible 偏正式，问是否符合条件，适合优惠规则复杂时确认。

items.zh: 这个买了多久之内可以退？
items.scene: 你打算买但不确定尺码，先问店员退货政策

answers.en: How long do I have to return this?
answers.note: 问退货期限的常用说法，直接清楚，适合购买前确认。

answers.en: What's your return window?
answers.note: return window 是退货期限的固定说法，简洁，像常网购的人会问。

answers.en: If it doesn't work out, how many days do I have to bring it back?
answers.note: 更口语，it doesn't work out 指不合适，适合边挑边和店员聊。

items.zh: 这件毛衣能机洗吗？
items.scene: 朋友借你一件毛衣，你准备洗，先问她

answers.en: Can I machine-wash this sweater?
answers.note: machine-wash 是机洗的动词说法，直接问洗涤方式，适合确认标签。

answers.en: Is this sweater okay to throw in the washer?
answers.note: throw in the washer 很口语，轻松，适合朋友之间借衣服时问。

answers.en: Does this need to be hand-washed, or can it go in the machine?
answers.note: 给出两个选项确认，hand-washed 对比机洗，适合怕洗坏时。

items.zh: 这件衣服洗完之后缩水了，还能换吗？
items.scene: 你拿着洗过一次但缩水的T恤，回店里问

answers.en: This shrank after I washed it. Can I still exchange it?
answers.note: shrank 是缩水的过去式，先说明再问，语气平和，适合正常协商。

answers.en: It came out of the wash a size smaller — is there anything you can do?
answers.note: 描述更生动，anything you can do 委婉求助，适合不确定能否换。

answers.en: The shirt shrank in the wash. Am I stuck with it?
answers.note: am I stuck with it 带无奈自嘲，适合店员态度冷淡时试探。

items.zh: 这条裤子会不会显得腿短？
items.scene: 你在试衣间穿好裤子，问外面的朋友

answers.en: Do these pants make my legs look short?
answers.note: 直接问视觉效果，中性，适合朋友之间快速确认。

answers.en: Do these pants make me look stubby?
answers.note: stubby 带自嘲，意思是显腿短粗，比 short 更形象，适合熟人。

answers.en: Do these pants work for my height, or do they make me look shorter?
answers.note: work for my height 更委婉，带点自嘲，适合不想问得太直接。

items.zh: 这个布包能洗吗？上面有咖啡渍。
items.scene: 你拿着帆布包到干洗店，指着污渍问

answers.en: Can this canvas bag be cleaned? There's coffee on it.
answers.note: 先问能不能洗再说明污渍，清楚直接，适合普通干洗店。

answers.en: Is it safe to wash this bag, or will it ruin the shape?
answers.note: 担心洗坏版型，safe 和 ruin 带顾虑，适合较贵或定型的包。

answers.en: Do you clean bags like this? It's got a coffee stain.
answers.note: 先确认店是否提供洗包服务，适合第一次进这家店时。

items.zh: 你们的试衣间在哪儿？
items.scene: 在服装店找不到试衣间，问店员

answers.en: Where's the fitting room?
answers.note: 最常用，fitting room 是美式说法，简短，适合直接问店员。

answers.en: Could you point me to the dressing rooms?
answers.note: 更礼貌，point me to 请对方指路，适合面积大的商场店。

answers.en: Where do I try these on?
answers.note: 最口语，直接说试穿，适合小店或店员正忙时。

items.zh: 这双鞋打完折还要八百，值吗？
items.scene: 你和朋友逛街，看中一双鞋，犹豫要不要买

answers.en: These are still eight hundred after the discount. Worth it?
answers.note: Worth it? 极口语，省略主语，适合朋友间快速征求意见。

answers.en: Do you think these are worth eight hundred, even on sale?
answers.note: 完整问句，even on sale 强调打折后还贵，带明显犹豫。

answers.en: Is eight hundred a fair price for these, or am I overpaying?
answers.note: fair price 与 overpaying 更理性，适合认真比较预算时。

items.zh: 白色的包是不是很容易脏？
items.scene: 在店里看一个白色帆布包，问同行的朋友

answers.en: Does white get dirty easily?
answers.note: 泛指白色，简短，像随口一问，适合刚看到包时。

answers.en: Is a white bag going to look dirty fast?
answers.note: look dirty fast 强调外观很快变脏，比泛问更具体。

answers.en: Will I have to clean a white bag all the time?
answers.note: 带担心维护麻烦，all the time 夸张，适合实用派朋友之间。

items.zh: 这件毛衣会起球吗？
items.scene: 在店里摸一件毛衣，问旁边的店员

answers.en: Will this sweater pill?
answers.note: pill 是起球的标准动词，简短专业，适合直接问材质。

answers.en: Does this sweater start pilling after a few washes?
answers.note: 更具体，问洗几次后会不会起球，带顾虑，适合想买耐穿的。

answers.en: Is this going to get those little fuzz balls on it?
answers.note: 最口语，用 fuzz balls 描述毛球，适合不知道 pill 这个词时。
